title: The power-series term function respects CReal.Equiv in its evaluation point
statement: For a coefficient sequence c, index j, and points p, q : CReal with p Equiv q: powerSeriesTerm c j p is Equiv to powerSeriesTerm c j q. Proved directly from CReal.pow_congr (Equiv p q -> Equiv (pow p j) (pow q j)) and CReal.mul_congr against reflexivity on the coefficient factor c j -- no induction on j is needed, since pow_congr already performed the induction on the exponent internally.

formal.statement: theorem CReal.powerSeriesTerm_congr : ((x0 : ((x0 : AxNat) -> CReal)) -> ((x1 : AxNat) -> ((x2 : CReal) -> ((x3 : CReal) -> ((x4 : CReal.Equiv x2 x3) -> CReal.Equiv (CReal.powerSeriesTerm x0 x1 x2) (CReal.powerSeriesTerm x0 x1 x3))))))

evidence.supports: CReal.powerSeriesTerm_congr is admitted by the trusted kernel gate with the type recorded in formal.statement.
